content: Usage of additional directPdu in case of variable length sdu In case of variable length sdu (with system signals of variable length) an additional directPdu is required: • it is used if the current length of this sdu is up to 8 bytes. • if the current length of this sdu is higher than 8 bytes the sdu will be transported via the dataPdu .
